shared_elements: a living creature with a frontal face (eyes and mouth/muzzle)
justification: The only correspondence is that both depict living beings with recognisable eyes and mouths: A a single, highly schematic frontal creature/figure reduced to an ovoid mass with gouged eyes, a beak-like nose and stubby arms, B a crowded narrative hunt with chariot, harnessed horses, archers and lions in profile. There is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme, and the conventions are opposite (blocky abstraction versus detailed naturalistic profile drawing with modelled musculature and internal detailing).
